# opnsense_dnsmasq_tag (Data Source)

Dnsmasq tags (**Services ▸ Dnsmasq DNS & DHCP ▸ DHCP tags**) label DHCP clients, ranges and options so options can be sent selectively.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the dnsmasq tag.

### Read-Only

- `tag` (String) Name of the tag.
